g.text: Does the model actually answer with the target animal?

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Qwen3-8B · native output-row fits · internal weights fixed · endpoint metrics

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Diamonds: fresh compilation. Circles: fit-process evaluation. Open markers: before fitting.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19343b

g.text: Correct-token probability uses the full vocabulary, not renormalization over two choices. Top-token accuracy uses the actual argmax.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: 95% intervals from 5,000 resamples: whole prompt pairs; new families use whole-family resampling with equal weights. One fit per task.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: * Reworded questions reuse the unseen-context test examples; the two test rows are not independent replications. No selection uses test outcomes.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Intervals exclude training-seed and hardware uncertainty. Zero-width bootstrap intervals do not eliminate population uncertainty.
